targets.title: Cognitive gains in 7-month-old bilingual infants.
targets.evidence_quote:
We present an exact replication of Experiment 2 from Kovács and Mehler’s 2009 study,
which showed that 7-month-old infants who are raised bilingually exhibit a cognitive
advantage.
targets.outcome_quote:
Our results did not replicate the original findings:
although anticipatory looks increased slightly during post-switch trials for both groups,
bilingual infants were not better switchers than monolingual infants.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that their new multicenter study did not replicate the original findings. New analyses concern this new sample, not original-data reproduction.
